scripts.build: pnpm --filter @auto-world/demo-search-contract build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/verify-production-build.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @auto-world/connector-sdk build && pnpm --filter @auto-world/demo-search-contract build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @auto-world/connector-sdk build && pnpm run build && node --conditions=auto-world-demo --test test/*.test.mjs
